ambient_events: The landward end of a boom swings its shadow across the slab and holds there.
Something heavy sets down on the quay across the water, and the deck feels it.
Water slaps the columns under the deck and draws back.
A tannoy on the quay says four words. None of them carry.
description: A length of the pier running past the foot of the quay. The gantries stand EAST across a strip of open water, near enough that the landward end of a boom passes overhead and lays a bar of shadow down the slab. Cleats the size of anvils stud the edge along here, and every one of them has been used. The tower is NORTH.
name: Pier
